تعرقبنا (form IIq)
# تَعَرْقَبْنَا (taʕarqabnā) /ta.ʕar.qab.naː/: first-person plural past active of تَعَرْقَبَ (taʕarqaba)
# تُعُرْقِبْنَا (tuʕurqibnā) /tu.ʕur.qib.naː/: first-person plural past passive of تَعَرْقَبَ (taʕarqaba)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
